title: Irish illness data shows more reports of major pathogens
summary:
Infection data from Ireland has revealed an increase in most major pathogens this past year with Salmonella at its highest level since 2008.

Figures come from a report published by the Health Protection Surveillance Centre (HPSC) that includes foodborne illnesses in the last quarter and all of 2025.
